# Comparisons

This folder contains detailed comparison tables and quality indicator evaluations from the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) annual reports. It catalogs national, regional, and departmental performance across seven clinical quality indicators, alongside demographic and clinical characteristics of pediatric and adult IBD patients. The pages provide cross-sectional snapshots of diagnostic workups, biologic and targeted synthetic drug (BMSL) treatments, surgical interventions, and patient education, tracing every metric back to specific tables in the 2023 and 2024 source PDFs.

## Pages

- [[aarsag-til-ikke-opfyldt-indikator|Årsag til ikke opfyldt indikator]] — Breaks down the specific medical examinations omitted when pediatric IBD patients fail to meet the Indicator 1b diagnostic workup standard.
- [[appendikstabel-1-patientkarakteristika-pr-behandlende-region|Appendikstabel 1. Patientkarakteristika pr. behandlende region]] — Compares demographic and diagnostic profiles of IBD patients across Denmark's five administrative regions.
- [[appendikstabel-2-afdelinger-der-har-indrapporteret-undervisningskoder-i-perioden-indikator-2|"Appendikstabel 2. Afdelinger, der har indrapporteret undervisningskoder i perioden (indikator 2)"]] — Lists hospital departments and their utilization of the BIKE1 teaching code for IBD patient education.
- [[appendikstabel-3-karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-indikator-4|Appendikstabel 3. Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL (indikator 4)]] — Contrasts the age, gender, and diagnostic distributions of pediatric and adult patients receiving biologic and targeted synthetic drugs.
- [[appendikstabel-4-type-og-antal-behandlinger-med-bmsl-indikator-4|Appendikstabel 4. Type og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 4)]] — Details the volume and proportional use of specific BMSL therapies, highlighting infliximab's dominance in pediatric care.
- [[appendikstabel-5-typer-af-kirurgiske-indgreb-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Appendikstabel 5. Typer af kirurgiske indgreb foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Catalogs the frequency of specific surgical procedure codes performed on IBD patients, led by laparoscopic colectomies and ileostomies.
- [[appendikstabel-6-typer-af-re-operationer-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Appendikstabel 6. Typer af re-operationer foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Breaks down the types of re-operations required within 30 days of initial IBD surgeries.
- [[appendikstabel-7-karakteristika-for-patienter-med-psc-indikator-7|Appendikstabel 7. Karakteristika for patienter med PSC (indikator 7)]] — Compares the demographics and hospital contact patterns of newly diagnosed versus prevalent patients with primary sclerosing cholangitis.
- [[indikator-1a-andelen-af-nydiagnosticerede-voksne-med-ibd-der-har-faaet-foretaget-relevant-udredning|"Indikator 1a: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede voksne med IBD, der har fået foretaget relevant udredning"]] — Evaluates regional and departmental compliance in performing relevant diagnostic investigations for newly diagnosed adult IBD patients.
- [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] — Tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed children and young people receiving the full recommended three-part diagnostic workup.
- [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] — Measures the regional variation in delivering patient education to newly diagnosed IBD patients within one year of diagnosis.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Assesses the rate of post-operative colonoscopies within one year for adult Crohn's disease patients who underwent ileocecal resection.
- [[indikator-4-andelen-af-patienter-med-ibd-i-behandling-med-bmsl-der-faar-maalt-f-calpro-mindst-en-gang-aarligt|"Indikator 4: Andelen af patienter med IBD i behandling med BMSL, der får målt F-calpro mindst én gang årligt"]] — Compares national and departmental adherence to annual fecal calprotectin monitoring for patients on BMSL therapies.
- [[indikator-4-andelen-af-steroidkure-givet-til-patienter-over-50-aar-med-ibd-hvor-patienten-har-faaet-foretaget-dexa-scanning|"Indikator 4: Andelen af steroidkure givet til patienter over 50 år med IBD, hvor patienten har fået foretaget DEXA-scanning"]] — Evaluates the low compliance rates for DEXA bone density scanning among older IBD patients receiving steroid treatments.
- [[indikator-5-andelen-af-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-der-faar-maalt-f-calprotectin-mindst-en-gang-aarligt|"Indikator 5: Andelen af patienter i behandling med BMSL, der får målt F-calprotectin mindst én gang årligt"]] — Tracks the 2024 performance of annual fecal calprotectin measurements for BMSL patients, highlighting a sharp divide between high-performing pediatric and lagging adult units.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Monitors the 30-day re-operation rates following IBD surgical interventions, noting a national deterioration from 2023 to 2024.
- [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] — Tracks the 18-month colonoscopy screening rates for adult PSC patients to monitor colorectal cancer risk.
- [[karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-paa-landsplan-indikator-5|Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL på landsplan (indikator 5)]] — Provides a national demographic snapshot of pediatric and adult cohorts receiving BMSL treatments.
- [[karakteristika-for-patienter-med-psc-indikator-7|Karakteristika for patienter med PSC (indikator 7)]] — Contrasts the demographics and healthcare utilization of newly diagnosed and prevalent PSC patients.
- [[patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-boern-med-ibd-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2022-til-og-med-30-september-2023|Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente børn med IBD med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2022 til og med 30. september 2023]] — Details the 2022-2023 diagnostic, demographic, and contact profiles of pediatric IBD patients.
- [[tabel-1-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-boern-med-ibd-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2023-til-og-med-30-september-2024|Tabel 1. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente børn med IBD med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2023 til og med 30. september 2024]] — Updates the pediatric IBD patient characteristics for the 2023-2024 reporting period.
- [[tabel-2-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-voksne-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2022-til-og-med-30-september-2023|Tabel 2. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2022 til og med 30. september 2023]] — Compares the 2022-2023 demographic and clinical profiles of newly diagnosed versus prevalent adult IBD patients.
- [[tabel-2-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-voksne-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2023-til-og-med-30-september-2024|Tabel 2. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2023 til og med 30. september 2024]] — Updates the adult IBD patient characteristics for the 2023-2024 reporting period.
- [[tabel-3-oversigt-over-indikatorresultaterne-paa-landsplan|Tabel 3. Oversigt over indikatorresultaterne på landsplan]] — Summarizes the 2024 national fulfillment of all clinical quality indicators against their development targets, including year-over-year comparisons.
- [[tabel-4-oversigt-over-indikatorresultaterne-paa-landsplan|Tabel 4. Oversigt over indikatorresultaterne på landsplan]] — Provides the 2023 national overview of quality indicator results, showing which metrics had complete follow-up data available at that time.
- [[type-og-antal-behandlinger-med-bmsl-indikator-5|Type og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 5)]] — Breaks down the exact volume and percentage of specific biologic and targeted synthetic drug prescriptions by age group.
- [[typer-af-kirurgiske-indgreb-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Typer af kirurgiske indgreb foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Lists the 2023-2024 SMR procedure codes for IBD surgeries, showing a dominance of laparoscopic interventions.
- [[typer-af-re-operationer-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Typer af re-operationer foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Catalogs the specific procedures performed during IBD re-operations, highlighting a high reliance on exploratory laparotomies.
